|lore=Able leader and captain of the Avenger. Was given his command by Admiral Ozzel. Treated with suspicion by Darth Vader and the Emperor, who distrust Ozzel's close advisors.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Avenger, that starship is also immune to attrition &lt; 4. You may re-target applicable Utinni Effects to Needa. While Needa in battle, your other non-'hit' characters here may not be forfeited.
